title: design-kb: content shapes
description: Names the shapes that book content takes, so the design process can identify a content's shape before proposing an activity pattern for it, and the book scan can tag content against it (CS-1). Seven shapes anchor on Horn's Information Mapping types (fact, concept, structure, classification, procedure, process, principle); eight are extensions for academic-skills content (contrast, parallel options, pairs, error, assembly, judgement, criteria, reflection). Sibling to design-kb.activity-patterns.json and design-kb.content-conventions.json in shape (kbVersion + a flat array of typed entries, additionalProperties false throughout); distinct job from content-conventions, which records conventions of built courses.

name.description: Short title, e.g. Concept, Contrast, Parallel options.

recognition.description: How a designer or the book scan identifies this shape in source material.

anchor.description: Where the shape comes from: one of Horn's seven Information Mapping types, or an academic-skills extension.

type.description: Required when framework is horn-information-mapping; forbidden otherwise.

examples.description: Optional. Each example is a verified sighting of the shape in source material.

ref.description: Stable anchor: the section heading, quoted exactly. Never a line number.
